title: Self-referential relationships
summary: A table FK-references itself (manager → reports, category trees).

example.code:
managerId Int? @map("manager_id")
manager LabEmployee? @relation("EmpTree", fields: [managerId], references: [id])
reports LabEmployee[] @relation("EmpTree")

body:
A table FK-references itself (manager → reports, category trees).

Why it matters: Org charts and nested categories live in one table. A self-FK (nullable for roots) models hierarchy without inventing extra tables.

SQL ↔ ORM: Same-table ForeignKey / Prisma self relation names (fields + references).
why: Org charts and nested categories live in one table. A self-FK (nullable for roots) models hierarchy without inventing extra tables.
objectives: Add nullable parent_id / manager_id referencing the same table's id.
pitfalls: NOT NULL on parent_id — then you cannot insert the root row.
mappingNotes: Same-table ForeignKey / Prisma self relation names (fields + references).
teachAlong: Cause: employee reports to another employee.
